_metadata.purpose: Define featured tags to show on section-type filtered pages
_metadata.description: Toggle tags highlight key generalist skills that hiring managers commonly filter by
_metadata.usage: These tags appear on /web, /print, /digital, /video pages if they exist in that section's entries

notes: Tags must exist as contextual tags (technology, media, skill) in JSON entries to appear
If a toggle tag doesn't exist in a section's entries, it won't be shown
Toggle tags only display on section-type pages, not on click-through contextual tag pages
Order in this array determines display order (left to right after subsection and role tags)
